'''Sterisi''' was the name given to members of a [[steris]] in the [[Adnerem]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' culture on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Adner]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Two sterisi who became particularly close might become a [[sterika]].
